name: The Center for Fiction Cafe
why_included: Quiet laptop seating in adjacent auditorium; indoor seating may close early on event days.

name: Devoción (Williamsburg)
why_included: Skylit roastery with sofas and tables; wifi weekdays only (off weekends); big room fits groups.

name: Conwell Coffee Hall
why_included: Art deco bank hall; three 8-seat communal tables, couches, fast WiFi, plugs; full bar; group-friendly but noisy.

name: Qahwah House (Broadway)
why_included: Two large floors of tables for quiet work or conversation, floor-to-ceiling windows; group-friendly.

name: Variety Coffee (Upper East Side)
why_included: Rare UES cafe with real indoor seating, reliable WiFi, lots of outlets; often full.

name: Partners Coffee (Long Island City)
why_included: Good wifi, bright and quiet; indoor seating laptop-free on weekends.

name: Battery Park City Library
why_included: Big windows over Teardrop Park; reviews cite ample seating with power outlets; can get noisy with kids.

name: Arlo SoHo
why_included: Library lounge with hidden outlets and 10-seat table, fiber Wi-Fi, lobby open 24h, grab-and-go cafe. Group table.

name: 875 Third Avenue atrium
why_included: Three-level atrium; required ~67 tables and 250 chairs; 2025 visitor photos show second-level tables; open to 11pm Mon-Sat. Group.

name: Washington Heights Library
why_included: Multi-floor renovated branch with new teen area and tech center; uptown study option.
